name: Kiell Smith-Bynoe
bio: Kiell Smith-Bynoe (March 5, 1989) is an English actor and writer. He is best known for his TV roles in Ghosts (2019-), Stath Lets Flats (2018-2019) and Enterprice (2017-2020).
